pull.author: tuner
pull.body: Deliver the one-worker evaluation result for the paper-repo position. The medium candidate changed only native reasoning effort and showed no judged quality difference in matched runs; both matched worlds exhausted their eight-execution budgets with unverified releases. The kept worker is therefore the target incumbent Codex gpt-6.1-sol at low effort, in candidate/kept/worker.json, with candidate/kept/config.json for continuation from rw_e584f68c0d9c. The candidate record cites the diagnostician evidence and the continuation validation. Referee should verify the final target-world round and its evidence before approval.
pull.title: Release kept incumbent worker and matched evaluation

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes at head fccb4aec6f457e1b58d0f4ea60b6c2c9d1873d4c. The delivery check is failing because judge/evaluation/putback.json is missing and the labels are not yet unblinded and compared. Judge has only committed per-result judgements (d63ee59); trial-user has not published its label table, complete run records, or a release, so no worker can yet be identified as kept and the PR claim that the incumbent is kept is unsupported. Please wait for the trial release and judge evaluation to include evaluation/putback.json, evaluation/runs.json, the label mapping and matched worker comparison, then ensure the target-world continuation round named by the PR is actually run and its records are available. Re-submit only after the delivery check passes and the exact PR head contains the kept worker/config files.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes at head 6ca9823655cb2b88d77014f6c0de429a53e853da. Trial-user has now published trial-v1, but the delivery check still fails: evaluation/putback.json is missing and the evaluation has not yet recorded the unblinded worker comparison or evaluation/runs.json. The PR’s kept-incumbent claim therefore remains unsupported. Judge must consume trial-v1, reconcile that the candidate run records name provisional revision 1dbc46f while the finalized worker is f1b4d00 (even if settings are identical), and commit the complete evaluation and put-back records. Approval also requires the target-world continuation round and its records, with the check passing at the reviewed head.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes at head 02c7ce0ed2b75f3bff9ea5c956b33197b5c46485. Judge now records both opaque labels, worker mapping, and a zero matched score difference, which supports keeping the incumbent, but the delivery check still fails because evaluation/putback.json is missing. The required target continuation rw_e4150b519eb4 is still running, with no terminal release/check evidence or recorded put-back round. Add the completed evaluation/runs.json and evaluation/putback.json, including the continuation world status, worker configuration, release/check result, and bounded run accounting; then resubmit only when the delivery check passes at the new head.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes at head 8b94ad67d7cf115e01b62545131ee5228c91ef4c. The judge comparison and matched-run records are now present, but the delivery check still fails: evaluation/putback.json is missing, and evaluation/runs.json explicitly excludes required put-back world rw_e4150b519eb4 because its continuation is not yet verified. Diagnostician reports the first drive ended without release and a second bounded loop is still processing the same world. Approval requires that loop’s terminal status, a verified target-world release/check, kept-worker settings and paths, and bounded accounting be recorded, then judge must add the putback record and include the final world in runs.json so all checks pass.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes at head 9258fab041d26a3fc412ecee264b7dc95d3fb263. The evaluation and put-back records now exist in judge, but the delivery check fails because .forgejo/CODEOWNERS assigns evaluation/.* to @judge. Judge does not read tuner pull requests, so Forgejo cannot request that review. Remove or reassign this rule according to the settled delivery ownership; keep the diagnostician-owned CODEOWNERS line and ensure the corrected head makes hutian/delivery pass. The put-back record currently documents an incomplete/unverified target continuation, so retain that evidence accurately when updating ownership.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes at head d906dcf009e8909fc526ca158873265e3a8a74b9. The CODEOWNERS issue is corrected, and evaluation/runs.json plus evaluation/putback.json now account for the put-back world, but hutian/delivery still fails because rw_e4150b519eb4 has no verified release and world_status is None. Its recorded round ended incomplete after the driver gap; release v1 and an approved final PR existed, but final was not merged. Finish that already-approved final PR in the target world, verify world_complete and the release/check status, then update the put-back and runs evidence and resubmit with a passing delivery check.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes at head fc19a5b2065ddb9aae303066ed138231cd2d2c06. The delivery check still reports put-back world rw_e4150b519eb4 has no verified release (world_status None). Diagnostician records that the world is stopped, the recovery job failed with world-not-running, and final PR #9 was never merged; the existing round therefore cannot satisfy the put-back requirement. Start a fresh bounded continuation from the target world’s newest checkpoint with candidate/kept config, drive it through a verified final release, and publish its complete world status, release/check result, and turn ledger. Update evaluation/putback.json and runs.json, then resubmit with hutian/delivery passing.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes at head 475950da71d24fa00f00b9ebce06a344bd51444a. The previous put-back world remains unverified, so hutian/delivery still fails. A fresh continuation rw_f0c559601c44 has now been created and bounded job cmd-5c30a3b2db started, but no terminal world_complete/release/check or turn-ledger evidence has been published yet. Wait for that drive to finish, replace the failed put-back entry with its verified records, and resubmit only after the delivery check passes.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes at head 7e57cd77c2b050c888a5de1ad995a59370b6cfe4. Judge now points putback.json to fresh world rw_f0c559601c44, but hutian/delivery still fails because that world has no verified release. Its first drive completed 8 executions with release_status=unverified/world_complete=false; a second bounded drive cmd-79964db03d is still running to discharge open obligations. Publish terminal evidence from that drive, require verified world completion/release and turn ledger, then replace the failed runs entry and resubmit with the delivery check passing.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Request changes: the evaluation is internally inconsistent at this head. Judge evaluation/runs.json at current commit 10332d59 classifies put-back world rw_f0c559601c44 as failed/unmeasured because host status was unavailable, while tuner candidate/kept/record.md claims the same round is verified from diagnostician c2db074 with result:final 69235c735d9fee7b32567d01711e565ea110a831. The required target-world round is therefore not supported by the judge record. Reconcile and publish the judge-owned evaluation/putback.json and evaluation/runs.json with admissible terminal evidence (or explain why the diagnostic record is inadmissible), then update this delivery to match. Held-out judgements, label mapping, trial-v1 release, and worker checks were inspected and do not resolve this put-back contradiction.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Approved at head 44cb362. Judge answered issue #4 at cdda0e4: evaluation/runs.json now marks rw_f0c559601c44 measured and cites admissible diagnostician terminal evidence (world_complete=true, accepted=true, release_status=verified, result:final 69235c7, 12 executions/294.1587 seconds and complete role ledger). The blind held-out judgements and trial-v1 label/run release identify equal zero scores and keep the incumbent. The kept low-effort Codex gpt-6.1-sol worker and world configuration are present at this head and worker check passes.

reviews.author: referee
reviews.body: Approved at refreshed head 9383340. The current hutian/delivery check is successful. Judge evaluation/runs.json now records both put-back worlds with verified releases as measured (latest reconciliation dab6758), while the final kept-worker put-back remains rw_f0c559601c44 with c2db074 terminal evidence and result:final 69235c7. Held-out blind judgements and trial-v1 records show equal zero scores and keep the incumbent. The kept low-effort Codex gpt-6.1-sol worker/config are present at this head and worker check passes.
